agent.name: claude-code
agent.repository_guidance: disabled using CLAUDE_CODE_DISABLE_CLAUDE_MDS and CLAUDE_CODE_DISABLE_AUTO_MEMORY; fresh HOME, empty setting sources

retrieval.embedding_configuration_source: Pinned main ci-config.json embedding_models.remote; historical published Claude+Opus profile used this embedding family.
retrieval.query_policy: Preserve native main MCP schema and instructions (including its semantic-search guidance); no additional benchmark-specific tool forcing.
retrieval.index_setup: before timed solver; cloned per trial; separately recorded
retrieval.identity_limit: Native catalog/request model and stored index identity can be verified; provider response parsing does not attest a resolved model or immutable weight revision.

completion_control.counting: Every unique repository tool_use_id consumes one admission, including tools later failing; all tools share one cap. Duplicate hook events are idempotent. Parallel calls are serialized by a file lock.
completion_control.mechanism: Native Claude PreToolUse command hook; after either budget limit deny new repository tools and request final answer from current evidence. Under budget omit permissionDecision, preserving ordinary permissions.
completion_control.not_guaranteed: No hard separation into a second model invocation. Already running work is not interrupted at 600 seconds. Denial leaves an opportunity to answer but the model may continue requesting denied tools or exhaust total time/turns. Such outcomes remain failures.
completion_control.information_policy: Generic budget/stop/uncertainty text only. No gold, source symbols, issue resolution, content filtering, suggested search terms or task-specific hint.

preflight.grant: Persist workspace grant for /workspace, exact model and endpoint; clone grant and signing-key state privately into MCP probe and zg trial; no provider key persisted.
preflight.index: Remote indexing is outside timed QA; fail before trials on identity, authorization, readiness or private-seed credential-scan error.
preflight.mcp: Real native initialize/tools-list and the unchanged fixed hybrid query at /workspace, followed by one vector-only call with the same non-task-specific query and limit=1. Require a returned vector-matched result, not just FTS success. Use independent seed clones, same restrictions and UID; discard query caches. No LLM call, but both searches may incur remote embedding charges; agent MCP schema remains unchanged.
preflight.baseline: No embedding credential/endpoint environment, no authorization/index seed, no zg MCP.
preflight.qa_independence: Setup success does not count as QA retrieval adoption, useful evidence, or e2e benefit; actual QA calls must independently meet the frozen signal rule.

accounting.index_setup: Measure grant separately and index plus readiness separately; all remote indexing traffic/cost outside QA metrics.
accounting.preflight: Report whole preflight plus hybrid and vector-only search walls separately, outside QA metrics; each includes native processing and any remote embedding/network time, not network-only latency. Two native preflight searches, no claim about the number of underlying HTTP requests or provider billing.
accounting.agent: All query-time remote embedding/network waits remain inside zg agent wall and investigation budget; never subtract them. No separate HTTP latency/token/billing telemetry is claimed.
accounting.cost: Provider-reported agent cost remains unverified. Remote embedding usage/cost unavailable unless separately returned and audited; no combined USD claim.

evaluation.primary: source_grounded_success under the separately frozen q004 rubric. Grade delivered final answers only; report factual points and per-claim citation support separately.
evaluation.quality_review: Fresh blinded Codex source review with arm mapping, resource metrics and previous answers hidden; not human or official SWE-QA evaluation.
evaluation.quality_interpretation: Report source-grounded pass/fail and factual points together. A pass-rate or citation improvement accompanied by a factual-score decrease is mixed, not overall quality dominance. One pair supports an exploratory observation only.
evaluation.resources: Complete total agent input including cache, input excluding cache-read, output, tool attempts/admissions/errors and wall; incomplete usage is unavailable for efficiency comparisons. Keep remote query waits and hook overhead in agent wall. Index, grant and preflight are separate setup costs.
evaluation.efficiency_interpretation: Only call the pair an efficiency improvement if both answers pass, zg factual points are at least baseline, input including cache is lower, protocol and usage are valid, and at least one correct-root zg retrieval succeeds. Report wall independently. Lower tokens on failed or incomplete answers do not establish efficiency.
evaluation.retrieval_attribution: Separately inspect actual QA correct-root success and evidence usefulness; preflight or setup success does not establish QA adoption or e2e benefit. Do not force a tool call.
evaluation.retention: Retain both planned outcomes including no answer, low score and tool failures. Infrastructure failure stops the affected pair and preserves partial evidence. No automatic repeat, task replacement or favorable-only selection. All prior phases keep their original rules.
evaluation.scope: Single architecture development pair, no stable suite benefit, contamination-free, population significance or embedding-causality claim.

status: Frozen for exactly one development pair; no new solver outcomes exist at freeze.
motivation: Two previously observed cases contain source counterevidence delivered before unsupported final claims. Add one explicit draft-to-existing-evidence consistency step, beyond existing citation/uncertainty advice, as a weak testable development hypothesis.
changed_factor: One generic shared final-answer verification suffix, applied identically to both arms. No added model invocation, retrieval pass, tool or budget.
development_selection_disclosure: q004 is deliberately reused after inspecting its initial outcome and a q002 ancillary error. This is retrospective protocol development, not blinded task selection, causal prompt attribution, confirmation or held-out validation. All prior outcomes/rules remain unchanged.

quality_rule.candidate_quality_signal: zg passes, baseline fails, zg factual points >= baseline, both completed with valid protocol/usage and at least one successful correct-root zg retrieval.
quality_rule.quality_tie: If both pass, no primary quality gain; any efficiency claim still requires old joint efficiency conditions.

prospective_decision.efficiency_rule: Both pass, zg factual points >= baseline, complete total input including cache lower, protocol/usage valid, correct-root successful retrieval; wall independent and setup separate.
prospective_decision.stop_rule: If neither the candidate quality signal nor unchanged efficiency signal is present, stop this q004 shared-instruction branch; no more wording revisions or same-case re-runs to seek success. Retain all outcomes.
limits: Cross-case diagnostic selected known errors; does not estimate error prevalence or baseline-versus-zg error rates.
One post-observation development pair cannot establish causal prompt effects, internal self-check execution, replication or held-out generalization.
Qualifying or removing unsupported required claims still loses frozen rubric credit.
No conclusion from fewer tools or successful MCP alone.
Original favorable-set goal is not complete merely because a new protocol runs or one candidate appears.

implementation_status: 101 offline tests passed; independent execution review found no blocking findings; exact old default behavior and shared new command/manifest prompt verified.
